titre: Reporting your separation to the CSSM
resume: Report the separation in "Mon Compte" on caf.fr so the CSSM recalculates your benefits on your income alone, and arrange how the allowances are paid when the children live with both parents.
aQuoiCaSert: In Mayotte, family benefits are managed by the CSSM (Caisse de sécurité sociale de Mayotte, Mayotte's social security fund), in the "Mon Compte" (My Account) area of the caf.fr website. After a separation, your entitlements (family allowances, complément familial (family supplement), housing benefit, CMG...) are recalculated without your ex-partner's income. Reporting the change quickly opens new entitlements and avoids having to repay overpayments.
quiEstConcerne: Any CSSM beneficiary who separates, whether they were married, in a PACS (civil partnership) or living together.
The ex-partner who was not the beneficiary and must open their own file to receive benefits.
Parents with shared residence, who must agree on the beneficiary.
aSavoir: You log in to "Mon Compte" with the first 13 digits of your social security number. This is where you update your situation with the CSSM.
The complément de libre choix du mode de garde (CMG, childcare allowance) can be received by both parents in shared custody since December 2025 (CSSM).

The allocation de soutien familial (ASF, family support allowance) and child support intermediation by the ARIPA (Agence de recouvrement et d'intermédiation des pensions alimentaires, the child support collection agency) do not yet exist in Mayotte (planned for 2035). For unpaid child support, see the guide entry "Unpaid child support in Mayotte: your options".
Victim of domestic violence: the CSSM pays emergency aid on proof less than 12 months old (complaint, report to the public prosecutor or protection order).
